gap: Seed (clock Tue 2026-03-10 09:00 America/New_York): one to-do t1 'Pay rent' {when:'2026-03-10', project:'p_house', repeat:{mode:'schedule',every:1,unit:'month'}}. Two tabs (same context, same localStorage) both on #/project/p_house. Steps: (1) tab A ticks the 'Pay rent' row checkbox, creating the next occurrence N (when 2026-04-10). (2) Tab A double-clicks N to open its card and types nothing. (3) Tab B double-clicks N, presses End, types ' to landlord', presses Enter. Storage now has N 'Pay rent to landlord'. (4) Tab A clicks empty space; pressing Escape does the same. (5) Tab A unticks t1 with its row checkbox. Expected: tab A typed nothing, so the rename stays. CONTRACT: 'a typed title makes a next occurrence edited', and unticking takes back the occurrence only 'as long as that one is still open and unedited', so N should stay and t1 should reopen as a one-off. That is exactly what the control run (the same steps without tab A's card open) gives: t1 [ ] 'Pay rent' with no rule, and N [ ] 'Pay rent to landlord' repeating. Actual (2/2 clean runs, both close paths): at step 4, tab A's close() writes back the title it has held in its field since the card mounted (detail.js close: edit.value !== t.title -> updateTodo), so N becomes 'Pay rent' again. N's fingerprint then matches its spawnKey, so at step 5 reopen() drops N. Final storage is [t1 [ ] 'Pay rent', repeating] only, the tab B rows after reload are ['Pay rent'], and ' to landlord' is nowhere. The rename typed in tab B is lost, and the occurrence it was typed into is then deleted. No page errors. The storage listener reloads state, but sync() never refreshes the card's title field, so any close of a stale card silently overwrites the other tab. The project/heading menu's Complete All used twice completes the next occurrence too (occ 2, then 3). The When picker on a completed occurrence still edits its rule. Cmd+K with focus in the card title does nothing. bfcache restore is not stale (the page fully reloads).
why: Across two tabs, closing an untouched card writes its stale title over the rename typed in the other tab, and unticking then deletes the renamed occurrence as unedited: typed text and an occurrence are lost.
